opening.argument: The presentation promotes a Bitcoin-linked earning opportunity built around recruitment and progressively larger account tiers. It promises a “10% referral bonus for every member you personally introduce” and explains that recruits are placed on a “left or right side,” with later introductions becoming spillover. The compensation structure therefore depends on building both recruitment legs, while the presentation states that “binary bonuses are paid every week on the Bitcoin value in the weaker leg,” offering residual income. It directly urges viewers to “Join us today” and presents the opportunity as a journey to “financial freedom,” while directing participation through the recruiting relationship. Recruitment-dependent bonuses and solicitation are central to the opportunity.

citations.quote: you will end a 10% referral bonus for every member you personally introduce to Meru Trading International
The third person you personally introduce will become spillover for one of the people you introduced before as you can only place in your left or right side.
Join us today. Build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom.
